scripts.text:
[Riss]
Hello?
I found some beautiful places
while I travelled all over the world.
I am an adventurer.
Haha~
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你好？
我在环游世界的旅途中，
发现了一些美丽的地方。
我是一名冒险者。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Riss]
What? My name is...
'Bossnia Staff'?? No no...
Well, my name is not so important.
Sometimes you should be generous.
No time for considering that kind of small stuff
when you have to concentrate on more important things.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
什么？我的名字是……
‘波士尼亚职员’？？不不……
嗯，我的名字没那么重要。
有时候你应该大方一点。
当你必须专注于更重要的事情时，
就没时间去考虑那些琐事了。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Hum... anyway I want to say... something..
While I was travelling through some places,
I found a really fearful place.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
嗯……总之我想说……某事……
在我旅行经过一些地方时，
我发现了一个非常可怕的地方。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Most of the time when you come to a place,
there is one strong and fearful monster.
Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
大多数时候，当你到达一个地方，
那里会有一个强大而可怕的魔物。
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Riss]
But... but... in there...
There are lots of fearful and strong monsters in there...
That was really frightful.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
但是……但是……在那里……
那里有很多可怕且强大的魔物……
那真的令人恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
If I had reacted a bit later... a few seconds...
I might have been killed.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
如果我的反应再慢一点……哪怕只是几秒……
我可能就已经没命了。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
What?
You want to go in there?
Oh~ Boy~ you didn't get me.
In there.......
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
什么？
你想去那里？
哦~男孩~你没明白我的意思。
在那里……

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Uh... you already know?
Although you know the place, you want to go in...
Good, I will send you there.
But after you went there, don't hold
a grudge against me. It'll cost you 1 Reset Stone for 5 access.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
呃……你已经知道了？
虽然你知道那个地方，但还是想去……
好吧，我会送你去那里。
但去了之后，别怪我。进入5次需要1个重置石。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Uh... you already know?
Although you know the place, you want to go in...
Good, I will send you there.
But after you went there, don't hold
a grudge against me. Also it costs 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
呃……你已经知道了？
虽然你知道那个地方，但还是想去……
好吧，我会送你去那里。
但去了之后，别怪我。另外还需要5000泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
You don't have a ticket now.....
So come to me again with a Reset Stone later.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你现在没有入场券……
所以稍后带着重置石再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Would you really like to take the challenge?
Ok, just choose the course.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你真的想接受挑战吗？
好的，请选择路线。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Take care, boy~
Don't hold a grudge against me.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
保重，男孩~
别怪我哦。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
You don't have enough money...
Come back when you have at least 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你的钱不够……
等你至少有5000泽尼时再来吧。
